worksite-smith-bench.description: Iron-banded oak anvil stump, horned anvil, quench trough with smithing tongs, and charcoal or tool rack.

worksite-carpenter-bench.label: Joiner's workbench and timber
worksite-carpenter-bench.description: Heavy mortised workbench scattered with wood shavings beside a spoked wheel, cooper's cask, or stacked lumber.

worksite-mason-bench.label: Stonemason's banker and stone
worksite-mason-bench.description: Dressed ashlar block on timber rollers with chisels, square, stone chips, and carved drums.

worksite-press-yard.label: Pressing frails and vats
worksite-press-yard.description: Woven oil-pressing mats under a timber screw with storage amphorae, or a mash trough with tied grain sacks.

worksite-paper-yard.label: Papermaking boards and vat
worksite-paper-yard.description: Drying boards plastered with damp handmade paper sheets beside a pulp vat, beating trough, or wooden screw press.

worksite-ropewalk.label: Ropewalk wheel and hawsers
worksite-ropewalk.description: Spoked twisting wheel stretching hemp strands across notched stakes, coiled hawsers, and tarred naval cordage.

worksite-foundry-yard.label: Bronze foundry and moulds
worksite-foundry-yard.description: Cast bronze bells, vessels, or ordnance beside clay casting moulds, glowing crucibles, and stacked copper ingots.

worksite-soap-yard.label: Soap-curing towers and beds
worksite-soap-yard.description: Hollow cross-stacked towers of curing olive-oil soap beside a scored pouring bed, cutting bench, or boiling cauldron.

worksite-silk-yard.label: Silkworm racks and reeling swift
worksite-silk-yard.description: Bamboo cocoon-rearing trays, steaming cocoon basins feeding spoked silk-reeling wheels, and drying raw-silk skeins.

worksite-charcoal-yard.label: Charcoal clamp and sawpit
worksite-charcoal-yard.description: Turf-covered smoking charcoal kiln with rakes and sacks, or a raised oak log on trestles with a two-man pit saw.
